purpose: Remove one line from the visitor's shopping cart (the "x" link on /cart) and get back the re-rendered cart rows and totals as JSON.

query.name: cartItemId
query.description: Cart line id (the sci id from data-href of the remove link on /cart, NOT the product id). Integer. May also be sent as a form body field cartItemId (verified: model-bound from either place). Lines are scoped to the caller's own cart: an id of another visitor's cart answers success:false and leaves that cart untouched. Missing, empty, non-numeric or > int32 value gives 502 Bad Gateway.

contentType: none (empty body; body-less POST needs data '' / Content-Length: 0, otherwise 411). Optional application/x-www-form-urlencoded with cartItemId=<id>

bodyFields.name: cartItemId
bodyFields.description: Alternative to the query parameter; verified to remove the line when sent as form body with no query string.

success.bodySignal:
JSON {success:true, message:"The product has been removed.", cartItemCount:<number of LINES left, not the quantity sum>, cartHtml:<HTML of remaining cart rows, "


" when empty>, totalsHtml:<HTML of the Subtotal/Shipping/Tax/Total table; Subtotal cell is empty when the cart is empty>, displayCheckoutButtons:true}. $type is AnonymousType32.

failure.bodySignal: Business failure (already-removed id, unknown id, 0, -1, id of another visitor's cart): HTTP 200 JSON {success:false, message:"An error occurred during the removal of the product.", displayCheckoutButtons:true} (AnonymousType30, no cartItemCount/cartHtml/totalsHtml). Technical failure (cartItemId missing, empty, 'abc', 99999999999): HTTP 502 text/html Bad Gateway. GET: 404 HTML 'The resource cannot be found.'. POST without any body/Content-Length: 411 Length Required.

purpose: Return the header counters (cart lines/quantity, wishlist, compare); the cart page calls it after every removal to refresh the badges.

query.name: cart
query.description: True to include CartItemsCount; when omitted/False CartItemsCount comes back 0 (the UI sends cart=True and wishlist=True in two separate calls after a remove).

query.name: compare
query.description: True to include CompareItemsCount (sent only by the page-load variant).

success.bodySignal: JSON {CartItemsCount, WishlistItemsCount, CompareItemsCount} ($type AnonymousType37). CartItemsCount is the SUM OF QUANTITIES (lines Certina x3 + Tissot x1 = 4), unlike cartItemCount in the delete response which counts lines. Empty cart: 0.

failure.bodySignal: No failure observed; flags not set return 0 for that counter. The query flags (wishlist=True without cart=True returns CartItemsCount 0) were observed from the browser, only the full cart=True&wishlist=True&compare=True and cart=True variants were replayed with curl.

purpose: Read the cart page HTML; each line carries its remove link (data-href with the cartItemId) and, when empty, the text 'Your Shopping Cart is empty!'.

setCookies: ASP.NET_SessionId and SMARTSTORE.VISITOR on the first cookieless request
success.bodySignal: HTML. Line ids: data-href='/shoppingcart/deletecartitem?cartItemId=<id>' (data-action="remove") with data-name=<product name>. Empty cart: 'Your Shopping Cart is empty!' and no Checkout button, no totals table.

failure.bodySignal: No failure; an empty cart renders the empty-state text.

purpose: Return the mini-cart HTML fragment; after the last line is removed it shows the empty state.

success.bodySignal: HTML fragment. Empty cart: 'Shopping cart empty' / 'You have not added any product to your cart yet.' (class no-items).
